snippet.description:

Remastered is a free upgrade for players who own The Witcher 3 on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. It is also available for pre-purchase on Battle.net and Nintendo Switch 2.

snippet.title: Black Myth: Zhong Kui – 15 Minutes Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
With blood beneath my blade, I paint new rouge upon my face,
An old friend visits, in a dream taking place.
Old faces, bygone deeds, have vanished from my sight,
Still, I remember every one, by day and through the night.
Those bound by love grow old; the righteous road runs long;
Today's notes of grace or grudge define not the final song.
Who says the Underworld is far away? 
All the better—once more I'll walk along.

Today, Game Science unveils a brand-new 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui, the second title in the Black Myth series. The trailer offers a first look at the protagonist in combat, along with a glimpse of the story.

As the game is still in early development, all footage was captured in-game from a work-in-progress build running at a 21:9 aspect ratio. The final release may differ.

Official Website: https://gamesci.cn/zhongkui

Shadows stretching down the halls
Your keys still waited by the door
For hands that won’t come back once more..

One empty hook beside the frame
The smallest things still keep your name
Some people fit beneath your skin
That doesn't mean you let them in
Don’t mistake my calm for torn,
I know exactly what went wrong

It is, like a promise,  past its date
What to lose,  and what to save 
And I stand here inside this place
Where the silence, wears your face

I won’t beg for what is gone
I don’t feed what will not grow
No more waiting for a sign
I decide this life is mine
Yes, I decide this life is mine. 
I may bend, but I’ll be fine.

Like a road that leads back home
I nearly sent you something small

Making space where you once moved

Like my voice comes back around

I’ll keep walking through my fears.
